scope: 14 first-party contracts (NFT mint/debt suite: 1 minter, 1 forwarder, 1 recorder, 7 dispatchers incl. abstract base, 4 hooks)

sharedAxioms.checkedArithmetic: Solidity 0.8.20 throughout; no unchecked blocks, no assembly.
sharedAxioms.ownable: All stateful contracts are OZ Ownable(initialOwner); owner is trusted per Law 3.
sharedAxioms.dispatchModifierChain: ATokenDispatcherV2.dispatch is the single non-virtual entry: nonReentrant + onlyMinter + whenNotPaused. Concrete dispatchers override only internal _dispatch and MUST NOT redeclare those modifiers (they don't).
sharedAxioms.hookNeverZero: ATokenDispatcherV2.hook is set to a DefaultDispatchHook in ctor and setHook rejects zero, so hook.onDispatch is always callable (branch-free).

NFTMinterV2.sol.purpose: ERC1155Supply claim-NFT minter. Users call mint(index,recipient) -> pulls `price` of dispatcher.primeToken() from user to dispatcher, grows price, calls dispatcher.dispatch(), mints 1 claim NFT. Registry of dispatchers with per-index price/growth/disabled config.

externalEntryPoints.note: mints NFT with NO payment, NO dispatch, NO debt accrual, NO price update
minter is the dispatcher's _minter, so it can pause/unpause

invariants: nextIndex starts at 1 so index 0 is invalid sentinel; dispatcherToIndex==0 means unregistered.
tokenId == dispatcher index (resolvedTokenId = index).
H-01 fix: token is fetched from dispatcher.primeToken(), caller cannot spoof token.
CEI: price grown BEFORE dispatch; FOT-safe via balance-before/after -> actualReceived passed to dispatch.

inboundCallbacks.timing: AFTER price update + token transfer + dispatch; all state finalized. NFTMinterV2 itself has NO nonReentrant guard, but dispatcher.dispatch already returned (its guard released). Re-entrant mint() would be a full fresh paid mint. SURFACE for interaction scanner.

trustAssumptions: prime token is standard-ish ERC20 (FOT tolerated via actualReceived); no ERC777/hook token expected
authorizedMinters trusted to not mint unbacked NFTs (mintFor bypasses payment+debt)
scannerNotes: mintFor mints a claim NFT with zero backing and zero debt accrual by design (batch-minter path) — confirm no path lets a non-authorized caller reach it (guard present).

No reentrancy guard on the mint path; inbound ERC1155 receive callback on recipient after full state finalization — interaction scanner should confirm no economic reentrancy (price already grown, so re-entry just pays the new higher price).

BurnRecorder.sol.purpose: Shared append-only burn ledger. Authorized burners call burn(token,amount) to accumulate totalBurnt and emit tokenBurnt. Owner registers tokens for enumeration.
invariants: totalBurnt monotonic increasing; pure bookkeeping, holds no funds, transfers nothing.
burn(token,amount) trusts caller's reported amount — no reconciliation against actual token burn.
scannerNotes: totalBurnt is self-reported by the burner (BurnerV2), not verified against on-chain supply delta. Low materiality (informational metric).

MultiPooler.sol.purpose: Stateless batch forwarder: single authorized `pooler` submits an array of PoolCall rows, each forwarding one Uniboost.pool(amountIn,minPairOut,minTargetOut,minLP). All-or-nothing.
invariants: Holds no funds — pure forwarder. Each target Uniboost holds/spends its own prime.
MultiPooler must be registered as authorized pooler on each target Uniboost (setAuthorizedPooler) for forwarded calls to pass.
scannerNotes: pool() loops over calldata array; length is attacker-uncontrolled (onlyPooler = trusted keeper). Gas-bounded self-DoS at worst. Prior run L-11: same-pool-in-batch floor staleness — interaction concern, not local.
c.uniboost address is arbitrary within the batch — a target that isn't actually a Uniboost/hasn't authorized MultiPooler simply reverts the batch (all-or-nothing).

dispatchers/ATokenDispatcherV2.sol.purpose: Abstract base for all V2 dispatchers. Template-method dispatch: nonReentrant+onlyMinter+whenNotPaused external `dispatch` -> internal virtual _dispatch -> hook.onDispatch. Owns metadata, minter authorization, pluggable hook, pausability.
invariants: hook != address(0) always (ctor DefaultDispatchHook; setHook rejects zero).
_minter is the pause authority; owner sets it via setMinter.
A reverting hook reverts the whole dispatch (documented).
trustBoundaries: _minter (NFTMinterV2) trusted to call dispatch with honest amount and to gate payment.
hook is owner-configured; a malicious/wrong hook can revert dispatch or (for hooks lacking type-guard enforcement in the concrete dispatcher) silently under-accrue debt.
scannerNotes: setHook lets owner swap the debt-accrual hook. Only NudgeRatchet variants re-validate hook type inside _dispatch; base does NOT enforce hook identity. See M-04 asymmetry below.

dispatchers/BurnerV2.sol.purpose: Dispatcher that burns received token via IBurnable.burn(amount) and records it in BurnRecorder.
dispatchers/BurnerV2.sol.valueFlow: token arrives on contract via minter transferFrom -> _dispatch burns `amount` -> BurnRecorder.burn(token,amount). Hook: DefaultDispatchHook (no debt) unless owner sets one.
invariants: _token, _burnRecorder immutable.
Burns `amount` (FOT-adjusted actualReceived), not full balance.
trustAssumptions: MUST be registered as authorized burner on BurnRecorder or _dispatch reverts.
scannerNotes: Ctor does not zero-check token_/burnRecorder_ (prior Q-09). Low.

dispatchers/GatherV2.sol.purpose: Dispatcher that forwards received token to an owner-settable recipient via safeTransfer(amount).
dispatchers/GatherV2.sol.valueFlow: token on contract -> safeTransfer(recipient, amount). Hook default no-op.
invariants: recipient non-zero (ctor + setter enforce).
_token immutable.
forwards `amount`, not full balance.

dispatchers/NudgeRatchet.sol.purpose: USDC dispatcher forwarding full USDC balance to owner-settable batchMinter sink. Debt accrues via NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook on `amount`.
dispatchers/NudgeRatchet.sol.valueFlow: USDC on contract -> _dispatch sweeps FULL balance (>= amount) to batchMinter; base then hook.onDispatch(amount) accrues phUSD debt.
invariants: Ctor hard-guards token decimals()==6 (USDC).
_dispatch REQUIRES hook.hookTypeId()==keccak256('NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.v1') (M-04 fail-CLOSED guard) — reverts on wrong/no-op hook.
_dispatch re-asserts bal>=amount (defense-in-depth: forwarding < amount would mint unbacked phUSD).
Sweeps full balance: surplus over `amount` is over-backing (accepted design, DO NOT re-flag).
trustAssumptions: no rescueERC20 on this variant — stray USDC self-forwards next dispatch (documented)
scannerNotes: M-04 guard PRESENT here. Debt/transfer decoupling documented as accepted (always over-backs).

dispatchers/NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.sol.purpose: USDC dispatcher that HOLDS USDC on dispatch and only releases to batchMinter when a whitelisted releaser calls release(amount). Rate-control lever. Debt side identical to NudgeRatchet.
dispatchers/NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.sol.valueFlow: dispatch: USDC held on contract (NO transfer). Debt accrues via hook on `amount` at dispatch time. release(amount): safeTransfer held USDC to batchMinter. rescueERC20: owner can move any token incl. _token.
invariants: Ctor hard-guards token decimals()==6 (USDC).
_dispatch REQUIRES correct hookTypeId (M-04 guard PRESENT); performs NO transfer (view function).
DECOUPLED debt-vs-backing timing is intentional: phUSD debt may be realised via hook.pull() while USDC still held here (documented accepted).
release only RELOCATES existing backing; conserves total backing.
trustAssumptions: rescueERC20 CAN pull _token (USDC) leaving accrued debt under-backed — documented owner footgun / responsibility
scannerNotes: DEDUP-001 class: debt accrues at dispatch, USDC backing held here; if rescueERC20 pulls _token OR release lags while pull() mints phUSD, phUSD can be transiently/permanently under-backed. Documented as accepted design + owner power. Interaction/econ scanner should confirm the cross-contract backing invariant is only violable by trusted owner/releaser, not by an unprivileged actor.
prior L-12: pause does not freeze custody (rescueERC20/release not pause-gated).

dispatchers/Uniboost.sol.purpose: USDC(prime) dispatcher: buy-and-pool zap into a UniV2 target pool + optional prime donation split. _dispatch carves donationSplit% to recipient, retains rest; separate pool() (authorized pooler) swaps prime->pair->~half target and addLiquidity, LP accrues as protocol-owned liquidity.

externalEntryPoints.slippage: minPairOut, minTargetOut, minLP (post-check); addLiquidity min amounts are 0

dispatchers/Uniboost.sol.valueFlow: _dispatch: donationSplit% of `amount` -> recipient (safeTransfer prime); remainder retained. Base hook.onDispatch(GROSS amount) accrues debt on full amount. pool(): retained prime -> LP.
invariants: authVersion mechanism: poolerAuthVersion[x]==authVersion => authorized; incrementAuthVersion mass-revokes.
donationSplit <= 100; donation enabled only if recipient!=0 && split>0.
targetPool must contain targetToken; _pairToken derived.
Debt accrues on GROSS amount even though donationSplit% left the contract (same convention as BalancerPoolerV2).
trustBoundaries: router (UniV2) semi-trusted; pool() swaps are MEV-exposed but bounded by owner/keeper-supplied min-outs (interaction/econ concern).
scannerNotes: M-04 ASYMMETRY: Uniboost._dispatch does NOT validate hook type (no hookTypeId guard), unlike NudgeRatchet variants. If owner sets a wrong/no-op hook, dispatch succeeds and accrues ZERO debt (fail-open to UNDER-accrual — protocol over-backed, not unbacked). Prior L-09 flagged exactly this. Surface for scanner; direction is safe (under-mint) but breaks debt bookkeeping.
pool() executes swaps at block.timestamp deadline with caller-supplied min-outs; sandwich exposure is bounded by min-outs (prior L-06 stays Low). Econ/interaction scope.
addLiquidity uses 0/0 min amounts, relying on the two swap floors + minLP post-check.

dispatchers/BalancerPoolerV2.sol.purpose: USDS(prime) dispatcher: on dispatch wraps pooling portion USDS->sUSDS (ERC4626) and attempts a silent try/catch Sky-PSM donation of remaining USDS->USDC to batchMinter; separate pool(minBPT) (authorized pooler) adds single-sided sUSDS liquidity to Balancer V3 pool via unlock/unlockCallback. Debt accrues via BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook on GROSS amount.
dispatchers/BalancerPoolerV2.sol.valueFlow: _dispatch: poolingUSDS -> sUSDS (ERC4626 deposit); donationUSDS + any parked USDS -> try _psmDonate (buyGem) -> USDC to batchMinter, or park on catch. Base hook.onDispatch(GROSS amount) accrues phUSD debt. pool(): sUSDS -> Balancer BPT (protocol-owned). withdrawBPT/rescueERC20 owner exits.
invariants: _primeToken = IERC4626(sUSDS).asset() (USDS, 18-dp).
donation try/catch isolates PSM failure so mint never reverts; failed donation parks USDS and re-sweeps next dispatch (recovery mechanism).
_psmDonate floors gemAmt (dust to protocol, never over-credits); tout<=maxTout ceiling.
unlockCallback only callable by vault; _psmDonate only by self.
Debt accrues on GROSS amount regardless of donation outcome.
trustBoundaries: Sky PSM (owner-set psm addr) semi-trusted; wrong psm addr could misroute donation (owner footgun).
scannerNotes: M-04 ASYMMETRY: like Uniboost, BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch does NOT validate hook type. Wrong/no-op hook => zero debt accrual (fail-open under-accrual, over-backed). Surface.
BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook applies NO decimal scale — correct because USDS is 18-dp (scale would be 1). Confirm prime stays 18-dp.
getIdealBPT is non-view (mutates via router query) — callers must not treat as view in a staticcall context.
_psmDonate is external+self-gated; correct pattern for atomic try/catch rollback.

hooks/DefaultDispatchHook.sol.purpose: Null-object IDispatchHook. onDispatch is a no-op. Deployed by ATokenDispatcherV2 ctor so hook is never zero.
invariants: No state, no funds, no debt. A dispatcher using this hook accrues ZERO debt.
scannerNotes: This is the fail-open target: if a debt-bearing dispatcher (Uniboost/BalancerPoolerV2) is left on / reset to DefaultDispatchHook, dispatch succeeds with no debt. NudgeRatchet variants' hookTypeId guard rejects it; Uniboost/Balancer do not.

hooks/NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.sol.purpose: phUSD mint-debt accrual for NudgeRatchet(/DelayRelease). onDispatch adds (amount*1e12*ratio)/100 to mintDebt (gated to dispatcher). pull() (owner or recipient) mints accrued phUSD to recipient and zeroes ledger.
invariants: USDC_TO_PHUSD_SCALE = 1e12 fixed (USDC 6-dp -> phUSD 18-dp). Correct ONLY because NudgeRatchet ctor hard-guards token==6-dp. (M-03 class — scale matches dispatcher's guaranteed prime decimals.)
MAX_RATIO=200 (INCLUSIVE) — ratio up to 200% is settable.
pull mints phUSD == mintDebt with NO on-chain check that backing USDC reached batchMinter (relies on dispatcher forwarding + trust).
trustBoundaries: phUSD.mint is an external mint to a protocol token — this hook is a MINT AUTHORITY. Unbacked-mint risk is DEDUP-001 class.
scannerNotes: M-03 CHECK: 1e12 scale is correct against NudgeRatchet's 6-dp guard. Verify no path wires this hook to a non-6-dp dispatcher (setDispatcher is owner-only; NudgeRatchet's hookTypeId guard binds them mutually).

DEDUP-001: ratio up to 200% means phUSD minted can be up to 2x the USDC forwarded — by design (nudge reward), but debt can EXCEED backing when ratio>100. Econ scope: confirm the batchMinter/phUSD system intends over-mint at ratio>100 (higher ratio than the 50%-capped Balancer/Uniboost hooks).
pull()->phUSD.mint external call after mintDebt=0 (CEI correct) + nonReentrant.

hooks/UniboostMintDebtHook.sol.purpose: phUSD mint-debt accrual for Uniboost. Prime-decimals-aware: immutable scale=10**(18-decimals) read from prime token in ctor. onDispatch adds (amount*scale*ratio)/100. pull() mints phUSD to recipient.
invariants: scale=10**(18-primeDecimals), ctor requires decimals<=18. Dynamic (correct for 6-dp USDC=1e12 or 18-dp=1).
MAX_RATIO=50; setRatio checks newRatio > MAX_RATIO reverts (so 50 IS settable despite NatSpec saying 'strictly <'). NatSpec/comment mismatch — minor.
NO hookTypeId() function — Uniboost does not enforce hook type, so none needed by that dispatcher (but that's the M-04 asymmetry).
scannerNotes: M-03: scale read from prime token decimals at deploy — if Uniboost's _primeToken decimals differ from what this hook read, mis-scale. Both take primeToken independently in ctors; deploy wiring must pass the SAME token. Surface for wiring check.
Comment/guard mismatch: NatSpec says ratio 'strictly < MAX_RATIO' but code allows ==50. QA-level.
No hookTypeId => Uniboost cannot self-validate this hook (M-04 asymmetry, prior L-09).

hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.purpose: phUSD mint-debt accrual for BalancerPoolerV2. onDispatch adds (amount*ratio)/100 (NO decimal scale — USDS is 18-dp). pull() mints phUSD to recipient.
invariants: NO decimal scale: correct because USDS (BalancerPoolerV2 prime) is 18-dp. (M-03 class — matches prime decimals.)
MAX_RATIO=50 (same == boundary quirk as Uniboost hook).
No hookTypeId — Balancer dispatcher does not enforce hook type (M-04 asymmetry).
scannerNotes: M-03: unscaled math is ONLY correct for an 18-dp prime. If BalancerPoolerV2 is ever repointed to a non-18-dp prime this under/over-scales — but _primeToken is immutable = sUSDS.asset() = USDS. Safe as wired.

wiringGraph.mintFlow: User -> NFTMinterV2.mint(index) -> [pull price of dispatcher.primeToken() user->dispatcher] -> dispatcher.dispatch(nftMinter, actualReceived, extraData) -> ATokenDispatcherV2 [nonReentrant/onlyMinter/whenNotPaused] -> concrete _dispatch (value movement) -> hook.onDispatch(nftMinter, amount) [debt accrual] ; then NFTMinterV2 _mint(recipient) [ERC1155, onERC1155Received callback].

dispatcherToHook.NudgeRatchet: NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook [ENFORCED via hookTypeId guard] — sweeps USDC to batchMinter
dispatcherToHook.NudgeRatchetDelayRelease: NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook [ENFORCED via hookTypeId guard] — holds USDC, releaser releases
dispatcherToHook.Uniboost: UniboostMintDebtHook [NOT enforced — no type guard] — donation split + LP zap
dispatcherToHook.BalancerPoolerV2: BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook [NOT enforced — no type guard] — sUSDS wrap + PSM donation + Balancer LP

wiringGraph.hookMintAuthority: All 3 debt hooks call phUSD.mint(recipient, debt) on pull(). phUSD (IMintable) is an out-of-scope external protocol token; these hooks are its mint authorities. This is the DEDUP-001 unbacked-mint boundary.
wiringGraph.poolerGraph: MultiPooler.pool(PoolCall[]) -> Uniboost.pool(...) for each row. MultiPooler must be an authorized pooler on each Uniboost. Uniboost/BalancerPoolerV2 also directly authorize individual poolers (keepers).
wiringGraph.burnGraph: BurnerV2._dispatch -> BurnRecorder.burn(token,amount). BurnerV2 must be an authorized burner on BurnRecorder.
wiringGraph.pauseGraph: NFTMinterV2.setDispatcherActive (owner) -> dispatcher.pause()/unpause() as _minter. NFTMinterV2 itself paused by `pauser` addr.

crossCuttingAnomalies.desc: Only NudgeRatchet + NudgeRatchetDelayRelease enforce hook identity (hookTypeId==keccak256('NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.v1')) inside _dispatch. Uniboost and BalancerPoolerV2 do NOT validate their debt hooks. A wrong/no-op hook (incl. DefaultDispatchHook after a setHook mistake) makes those two dispatchers accrue ZERO debt while still moving value — fail-OPEN to UNDER-accrual (protocol over-backed, not unbacked). Direction is safe but silently breaks debt bookkeeping. Matches prior L-09. UniboostMintDebtHook & BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook expose no hookTypeId(), so the guard cannot even be added symmetrically without an interface change.

Three different scaling strategies, each correct against its dispatcher's prime decimals: NudgeRatchet hook fixed 1e12 (USDC 6-dp, ctor-guarded); Uniboost hook dynamic 10**(18-d) read from prime; Balancer hook unscaled (USDS 18-dp, immutable). No mis-scale found AS WIRED. Risk is purely deploy-time wiring: a hook constructed against a different token than its dispatcher's prime would mis-scale. Recommend wiring assertion in deploy scripts.

pull() on all 3 debt hooks mints phUSD equal to accrued mintDebt with no on-chain proof the backing token reached its sink. Backing integrity relies on: (a) dispatcher forwarding value (NudgeRatchet sweeps; DelayRelease holds then releases; Uniboost/Balancer convert to POL/donation), and (b) trusted owner/releaser not pulling backing via rescueERC20. NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook allows ratio up to 200% (phUSD minted up to 2x USDC forwarded) vs 50% cap on the other two — econ scanner should confirm >100% over-mint is intended for the nudge-reward design.

NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.rescueERC20 can withdraw held _token (USDC) that backs already-accrued (possibly already-pulled) phUSD debt, leaving it under-backed. Documented as accepted owner responsibility; owner-trust (Law 3) but a non-obvious footgun since debt already accrued at dispatch.

NFTMinterV2 has no nonReentrant guard; _mint(recipient) fires onERC1155Received AFTER all state finalized (price grown, dispatch done). Re-entry is a fresh fully-paid mint at the new higher price. Surface for interaction scanner to confirm no economic reentrancy.
Uniboost & Balancer debt hooks: NatSpec says ratio 'strictly < MAX_RATIO(50)' but setRatio uses `> MAX_RATIO` so 50 is accepted. Cosmetic doc/code mismatch.

weakRandomness: None. No block.timestamp/prevrandao/blockhash used for value-bearing outcomes (block.timestamp only used as swap/addLiquidity deadline and burn-event timestamp — non-entropy).
unboundedLoops: Only MultiPooler.pool iterates a caller-supplied array, gated to a trusted keeper (onlyPooler), all-or-nothing. No attacker-controlled unbounded loop.
